_comment: Every threshold below is copied from a verdict in your project. Null means the verdict gave none: add one BEFORE the first live trade, not after. Units must match what each bot logs (bp of the underlying, R, or usd).

apex_master_v2.notes: Rule: prior VIX close >= 20 AND prior-day IBS < 0.10, first of SPY/QQQ/IWM, long open to close. Paper-trade every signal day. Pause below -1,600 bp cumulative; retire at 40 trades if mean <= 0; test IWM exclusion once at 40 trades. 50% haircut applied because the VIX split was found post-hoc and ~130 tests were run. About 24 signals/yr, so expect 40 trades to take ~20 months.

apex_master_v1.notes: Benchmark is the live-executable first_fire rule (reliability -0.020R), NOT the published +0.306R, which needs whole-day hindsight. The Section 9 drawdown bar is -8R; the backtest already breached it (-12.8R). Decide the profile (reliability vs runner) before the first trade; changing later restarts the count.
apex_master_v1.blocked: v1 session off by default since 2026-11-13 (Apex-Master PR #3): live rule flat (-0.020R) with drawdown past its own -8R bar.

tier1_bot_h8.blocked: Strike rule selects ~2.21% OTM, a ~1-delta put, where the 33-year result is -$0.59/trade. Do not fund. Re-specify as a fixed 3.5-4.0% OTM distance and log the FILLS ladder first (h8-full-backtest-verdict-2026-11-01).

condor.notes: 0 of 7 real credit checks reached OK ($0.03-$0.27 vs the $0.44 bar); 0 logged fills. Patches in draft PR #3 (silent-failure alerts, kill-switch scaling) are NOT merged: merge them before relying on this bot.
condor.blocked: Retired 2026-11-13 (fleet scan): superseded by Premium-Sleeve; 0 of 7 real-credit checks reached the bar.

premium_sleeve.notes: Its only evidence is the index-level PUT result (holdout Sharpe 0.56, CAGR 6.9%, max DD -29%), not this spread structure with PT/SL. The gate in front of it was audited Tier D/E: gate (a) KILL, gate (b1) shelve as a return claim. Treat the gate as a risk preference, not an edge. Stop rule already in the bot's config (written before any trade): entries halt at a 15% drawdown from the sleeve's peak, restart only after 20 sessions with VIX/VIX3M below 1.00; per position 50% of credit, 2x credit stop, 21 DTE time exit.
premium_sleeve.blocked: At the $1,500 account setting the sleeve's 5% per-position risk cap sizes every 10-wide SPY put spread to 0 contracts (its README puts the floor near $20,000), so it cannot open a position or build a record. Kept at $1,500 by choice on 2026-11-13.

ibs.notes: Unit: bp of the entry price per closed trade, next-open to next-open, net of 1.5 bp a side (the bot's own execution rule and the verdict's cost). Benchmark +68 bp is the out-of-sample average trade at the next open, 2019-01 to 2026-09 (verdict range +0.6% to +0.8%; the full 1998-2026 history in the ADX verdict averages about +49 bp). No haircut: the rule was pre-registered and judged on untouched data. Retire rule is the verdict's kill switch (average trade below +0.2% over 100 alerts), applied here to the first 100 logged trades; the bot's own kill_switch_monitor.py applies it on a rolling 100 and also watches drawdown (25%) and win rate (60%). Load the bot's closed trades with: python -m trading_ops import-ibs. Watch item from the verdict: 2026 year-to-date was +8 bp a trade over 37 alerts.

momentum_sleeve.review_note: Re-run the bootstrap check (CI on Sharpe improvement over IBS-alone included zero). Also confirm fractional-share support before any real capital.

apex_chronos.blocked: P1 and P3 alerts muted 2026-11-13: forward model record 15 Oct to 12 Nov is P1 74 trades at -3.4% each, P3 6 trades at -10.3% each (model prices, not fills), and the audit found 0 Holm survivors. Logged only. P2 is judged separately as apex_chronos_p2.

bot_selector.notes: Replay showed no demonstrated value (n=5, CI includes 0). Log only its decisions and judge them against same-board alternatives; do not trade from it.
bot_selector.blocked: Session retired 2026-11-13 (fleet scan): no demonstrated value (n=5, CI includes 0) and a ranking layer is on the freeze's forbidden list.

apex_chronos_p2.source: Apex_Chronos docs/P2_DECISION.md (frozen 2026-11-13); backtest figure from docs/LIVE_VS_BACKTEST.md
apex_chronos_p2.notes: Unit: model ROI in percent of collateral per trade (Black-Scholes prices, not fills). Counts only P2 trades dated 2026-11-16 or later: the first 40 forward trades (+3.3% each, 72% winners) are what singled P2 out, so they cannot also confirm it. Decision at exactly 100 new trades, written down before any of them existed: KEEP if the mean is at least +1.0% of collateral and the day-clustered one-sided 95% lower bound is above zero; otherwise RETIRE. Stop early if the new trades sum to -100% of collateral. Keep means P2 stays a paper alert and may go to the real-quote gate; it does not mean fund it. The repo's EOD post prints the count and the verdict.
